title: The Static of Sector Nine
author: Felix Sandoval
blurb: Orsen Whitlock, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
